description: ZTE MF100 (19d2:0031, «ZTE WCDMA Technologies MSM», firmware BD_UAKVSP671A1V1.0.0B02): an old 3G (HSDPA) stick, no network function: QCDM on interface 00 (ttyUSB0), AT on 01 and 03 (ttyUSB1, ttyUSB2, the primary), storage on 02; ModemManager's zte plugin dials PPP. A tester's Nokia XG-040G-MD report, 2026-11-04 (OpenWrt snapshot, ModemManager 1.24)
